ordinary: Use ordinary causal analysis and a direct solution approach. Identify the best supported mechanisms/questions and concrete next probes; no special creativity instruction.
creative: Seek useful creative alternatives beyond the incumbent. Supply actual causal or observational differences, with constraints and unknowns explicit.
resist: Treat the stipulated disturbance/defect as something to prevent, resist or correct. Develop that approach and its discriminating probe without converting the disturbance into a useful resource.
carrier: Keep the essential work with its incumbent human/tool carrier. Improve or investigate that arrangement without transferring the function to another material, artifact or environment.
parent_a: Develop only parent A from the fixed parents fixture as the operational mechanism. You may test and refine its own function; do not add parent B or another replacement mechanism. State limits under the full case requirements.
parent_b: Develop only parent B from the fixed parents fixture as the operational mechanism. You may test and refine its own function; do not add parent A or another replacement mechanism. State limits under the full case requirements.
P01: Invert one causal arrow: hypothesize that the incumbent intervention or its organization helps manufacture its demand. Name the feedback path and a prediction when a changeable link is removed. Reject reversals without a different observation or that weaken the valued outcome.
P03: Turn an actual stipulated adverse input/defect into information, energy or control. Specify the conversion, useful and false responses, and failure boundary. Learning from failure without a conversion is insufficient.
P04: Join the exact parent A and parent B functions in the parents fixture at a named interface. Specify a capability and discriminator distinguishing the hybrid from merely adding their separate benefits. Each proposed opening must include component_comparison {baseline,parent_a,parent_b,hybrid,interaction_test} with predictions under identical case requirements. No simulated or observed outcome may be invented.
P05: Describe one concrete surprising future capability; expose missing dependencies and extract a currently testable enabling capability. Reject hidden magic or an enabling test indistinguishable from ordinary behavior.
P06: Move a function currently carried by the incumbent human/tool to a material, artifact, interface or environment. Specify carrier, causal path, maintenance burden and remaining human responsibility; do not merely rename a delegate.
P07: Preserve an awkward supplied observation. Generate two genuinely competing mechanisms explaining ordinary and anomalous cases, with one probe and observation on which they disagree. Never invent an anomaly or move the failure elsewhere.
